front_speed_closure.transform_identity: Differentiating y(X;Nc)=tD*sigma_BL with dy/dX=exp(-Nc*X) gives the same Xdot=exp(Nc*X)*sigma_BL.

Nc0_limit.PDE: the standard conservative incompressible BL equation expressed in the same moving fan coordinate

implementation_requirements: Differentiate network output with respect to xi.
Differentiate network output with respect to conditioner tD.
Differentiate network output with respect to conditioner xD_star.
Include Xdot*N_X in the physical time derivative.
Use physical raw Nc, never scaled Nc.
Use the exact fractional-flow implementation bound to Stage 2.
Use interior fan nodes for residual evaluation; do not enforce pointwise smooth-PDE residual across the shock discontinuity.
Validate analytical/autograd conservative-form and expanded-form residuals against each other before training.
